name: Hot Dog Crescent Roll "Mummies" with Ketchup & Mustard

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Pat hot dogs dry with paper towels. Halve crosswise, place on a plate, and set aside.
Open the crescent roll package and unroll the dough onto a flat surface. Pinch and press the diagonal (perforated) lines closed so that you have 4 rectangles.
Working one at a time, cut each rectangle lengthwise into 6 strips to use as "bandages" for wrapping the "mummies."

Wrap each hot dog piece with 2 bandages, crisscrossing them, and making sure to leave a space for the "face" at the uncut end. Place wrapped mummies on the baking sheet, spacing them at least 1-inch apart.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until the pastry is golden brown and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Using the end of a chopstick, dot mustard on the face of each mummy to create "eyes."
Arrange mummies on a platter; serve with ketchup and additional mustard for dipping. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ketchup
2 tbsp yellow mustard
